summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of LogiDiary Expo app on mobile viewport (390x844). Dashboard, tab nav, Fleet (add driver + vehicle), Trip creation with driver/vehicle picker, KPI update (Total Trips 0->1, Revenue ₹0 -> ₹15,000), trip filters, Profile save, and AsyncStorage persistence after full page reload all worked successfully.

issues: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be modernized.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver warning on web preview – expected on web, no action needed for on-device.

action_items: Optional: Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to clean warnings.
Note: Image picker (base64 photos, RC/License docs) not testable in web preview; verify manually on device.
critical_code_review_comments: All screens use testID correctly; forms have validation; INR formatting via formatINR verified (₹15,000).
AsyncStorage persistence confirmed after reload (profile name retained).
Trip totals correctly aggregate revenue within last 30 days window.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 driver (Ravi Kumar), 1 vehicle (Van MH01AB1234 Tata 407), 1 trip (Delhi->Jaipur ₹15000), and profile (Test User) via UI during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is stable. Only web-only warnings remain. Image upload flows require device-level testing.
rca_of_issue: No issues found in tested flows.
